_comment: The booking fingerprint written onto the world-readable /dinner cell in
place of the raw Mews booking id. bookingKey() lives in nala-shared.js
(the boards) and is force-copied into index.html (the guest page loads no
staff code). Both copies MUST produce these exact values: a guest's cell
and the board that reads it correlate by comparing fingerprints, so a
drift between the two copies would silently break every guest answer's
link to its booking. inv_suite's phone_cases pattern: add a vector here,
never to one copy, and whichever copy has not learned it fails by name.
Vectors are Mews GUIDs (isGuid enforces 8-4-4-4-12 hex) plus the empty
case; expected values were generated once and are pinned - a change to
them means the hash moved and every stored bkey would need re-deriving.
